# Game builds

A fact holds for the build it was last verified on. After a game update, a record still on an older build is unconfirmed until re-verified. Start with [topics/game-updates.md](topics/game-updates.md). Back to [the map](README.md).

## 210942

### Mechanisms last verified on it

- [edat-revision-chain](../components/core/knowledge/mechanisms/edat-revision-chain.md) (core): Game data is a chain of edat archives, read newest revision first (RE, 2026-11-12)
- [game-build-classes](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/game-build-classes.md) (ops): A game update removes and renames classes and properties; a mod's files may hold only those the installed build's stock holds (STOCK, 2026-11-12)
- [scenario-definition-layout](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/scenario-definition-layout.md) (ops): Build 210942 reads a scenario's Definition files as NDF/Scenarios/<scenario>/<Kind>.txn, each beside its .txn.tag and .dbg (STOCK, 2026-11-12)

## 201602

### Mechanisms last verified on it

- [add-unit-to-deck](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/add-unit-to-deck.md) (ops): AddUnitToDeck adds a card at load or mid-battle, a transport card included; added cards show in the battlegroup view (PLAYED, 2026-11-11)
- [ai-grid-tiles-playable-zone](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/ai-grid-tiles-playable-zone.md) (ops): The AI strategic grid must tile the playable zone (PLAYED, 2026-11-03)
- [arrival-end-in-zone](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/arrival-end-in-zone.md) (ops): Every player arrival entry must end inside a deployment zone of its side or a command zone (STOCK, 2026-11-04)
- [camera-shot-from-current-position](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/camera-shot-from-current-position.md) (ops): Mid-battle, a script flies the camera from wherever it is to a one-key path, in a cutscene that can hold the view (STOCK, 2026-11-11)
- [changestress-damagetype-zero](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/changestress-damagetype-zero.md) (ops): A script's ChangeStress damages with Physical and cannot suppress; DamageType 0 fails at load (PLAYED, 2026-11-11)
- [chinese-text-stock-glyphs](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/chinese-text-stock-glyphs.md) (ops): Simplified Chinese text must stay within the characters stock text already uses (PROBED, 2026-11-03)
- [content-identity-unique](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/content-identity-unique.md) (ops): Two mods cloned from one template must not share an identity (PLAYED, 2026-11-11)
- [count-race-forced-owner](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/count-race-forced-owner.md) (ops): Decide a zone by a timed unit count, then force its owner so the map shows it (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [crash-dump-names-the-error](../components/core/knowledge/mechanisms/crash-dump-names-the-error.md) (core): The crash report's dump names the real error (RE, 2026-11-03)
- [created-units-stand-in-zone](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/created-units-stand-in-zone.md) (ops): A script cannot hide a unit outside the playable zone; a unit created there stands on the zone's edge, where the player's units see and engage it (FAILED, 2026-11-11)
- [custom-operation-from-stock-parts](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/custom-operation-from-stock-parts.md) (ops): A custom Operation can be built entirely from cloned stock files plus a generated LevelDesign and GDScript (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [deployment-phase-recipe](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/deployment-phase-recipe.md) (ops): A deployment phase needs six parts, and buying after the launch needs player arrival entries (PLAYED, 2026-11-03)
- [detector-circles-only](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/detector-circles-only.md) (ops): DetectUnitDansDetecteur works only on circular zones (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [dialog-button-ingame-dictionary](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/dialog-button-ingame-dictionary.md) (ops): Dialog button labels resolve only in the game's in-game interface dictionary (PLAYED, 2026-11-03)
- [dialog-reask-loop](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/dialog-reask-loop.md) (ops): A multiple-choice dialog can be asked again in a loop if the choice is reset before each ask (PLAYED, 2026-11-11)
- [dialog-text-takes-no-variables](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/dialog-text-takes-no-variables.md) (ops): Dialog text cannot show live numbers; counts go in an objective counter or a hint (STOCK, 2026-11-04)
- [difficulty-branches](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/difficulty-branches.md) (ops): Difficulty reaches a script as three conditions; give it a Medium baseline (STOCK, 2026-11-06)
- [fast-move-and-attack-keeps-roads](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/fast-move-and-attack-keeps-roads.md) (ops): MoveAndAttack goes cross-country; FastMoveAndAttack and ForceRoad moves keep to roads (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [fog-switch](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/fog-switch.md) (ops): A script can switch the fog of war off with TGDDescriptorFow; whether it is map-wide and comes back on is unseen (PLAYED, 2026-11-11)
- [gameplay-mod-relaunch](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/gameplay-mod-relaunch.md) (ops): Operations and Gameplay mods don't mix; an Operation mod must ship none of the 16 Gameplay files (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [garrison-roe-and-hold](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/garrison-roe-and-hold.md) (ops): A garrison in a camp with no AI holds its ground only with the ROE and smart orders the script gives it (STOCK, 2026-11-11)
- [gdscript-is-what-loads](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/gdscript-is-what-loads.md) (ops): An Operation runs from its compiled GDScript (build 201602's ndfbin, 210942's .txn), a compiled form of the stock Python (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [helicopter-boarding](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/helicopter-boarding.md) (ops): Scripted infantry boarding of a helicopter does not work (FAILED, 2026-11-03)
- [kill-counts-by-type](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/kill-counts-by-type.md) (ops): Kill counts are by unit type, not by group; count a group's survivors instead (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [leveldesign-guid-binding](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/leveldesign-guid-binding.md) (ops): A script names a map item by the item's GUID in LevelDesign (210942 one GUID value, 201602 four words) (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [load-time-validation-rules](../components/core/knowledge/mechanisms/load-time-validation-rules.md) (core): Every object is validated at load, and the first broken rule stops the load (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [localisation-tokens-packed](../components/core/knowledge/mechanisms/localisation-tokens-packed.md) (core): Localisation keys are tokens of up to 10 characters, packed 6 bits each (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [mission-ends-only-by-script](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/mission-ends-only-by-script.md) (ops): With CheckEndGame off, only the script's TriggerEndGame ends the battle, and the first one wins (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [mod-version-and-config-lines](../components/core/knowledge/mechanisms/mod-version-and-config-lines.md) (core): A mod is active only with Gen/Version.ndf, and its [Config] hashes mark it outdated after an update (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [ndfbin-round-trip](../components/core/knowledge/mechanisms/ndfbin-round-trip.md) (core): Compiled NDF (CNDF ndfbin) decodes and re-encodes byte for byte (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [objective-counters](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/objective-counters.md) (ops): Objective text shows live counters from a variable list (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [objective-label-needs-position](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/objective-label-needs-position.md) (ops): An objective's map label needs a position, or it pins the map corner (STOCK, 2026-11-03)
- [objective-waits-until-resolved](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/objective-waits-until-resolved.md) (ops): An objective finishes only after it resolves and its chosen actions finish (PROBED, 2026-11-06)
- [operation-menu-registration](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/operation-menu-registration.md) (ops): A new scenario id in a mod's Scenarios folder is listed and launches; a stock name is not overridden (PLAYED, 2026-11-11)
- [script-container-semantics](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/script-container-semantics.md) (ops): How script containers run their children, and when each action finishes (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [script-effects-self-contained](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/script-effects-self-contained.md) (ops): A script launches a GameFx effect that takes no parameters, or a parameterised one through a wrapper of its own that binds them (PLAYED, 2026-11-11)
- [scripted-air-sweep](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/scripted-air-sweep.md) (ops): Hidden aircraft revealed, sent over a circle and sent home once spent give an AI-less camp air sweeps (STOCK, 2026-11-11)
- [scripted-economy](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/scripted-economy.md) (ops): A script sets the player's points, a zero income, one-time grants and a later income in stock's own nodes (STOCK, 2026-11-11)
- [scripted-fires](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/scripted-fires.md) (ops): A battery created just before its ShootOnPosition fires; created where the player's units can reach, it must be in their alliance (PLAYED, 2026-11-11)
- [scripted-nuke-effect](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/scripted-nuke-effect.md) (ops): A script plays the tactical-nuke impact effect only through a wrapper of its own that binds its parameters; a direct launch crashes the game (PLAYED, 2026-11-11)
- [seteffect-never-finishes](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/seteffect-never-finishes.md) (ops): SetEffect and other lasting actions never finish, so nothing after them in a Sequential ever runs (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [soviet-player-camp](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/soviet-player-camp.md) (ops): A clone of Survivors loads and plays with a Soviet player in the stock PACT-player camp shape (PROBED, 2026-11-11)
- [spawn-and-create-units](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/spawn-and-create-units.md) (ops): SpawnUnits reveals pre-placed units; CreateUnitOnPosition makes new ones at a tag (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [start-camera-before-loading-done](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/start-camera-before-loading-done.md) (ops): An Operation that opens in the deployment phase sets its opening camera after LoadingDone, a move then a snap to its last key (STOCK, 2026-11-11)
- [vanished-removal](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/vanished-removal.md) (ops): KillAllUnit with Vanished removes units at once; count them before you remove them (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [wave-ends-with-attack](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/wave-ends-with-attack.md) (ops): An AI-less wave stops at its last waypoint unless its route ends with an Attack on the player's units (STOCK, 2026-11-11)
- [weapons-jammed-effect](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/weapons-jammed-effect.md) (ops): The "weapons jammed" effect only zeroes weapon ranges; to keep a unit silent, empty its ammunition (STOCK, 2026-11-03)
- [zone-capture-command-units](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/zone-capture-command-units.md) (ops): Only command units capture a zone, and an enemy command unit inside makes it neutral at once (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
- [zone-lookup-by-point](../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/zone-lookup-by-point.md) (ops): Zone conditions find their zone by a tag's point, and a point in no zone fails silently (PLAYED, 2026-11-06)
